note: Free GPU compute: a section apart from the provider ranking. Nothing here is a provider of the LLM dataset and none of it enters a provider count, a score or a collection. A value is written only when the provider's own page states it, with the sentence and the day it was read; otherwise it is not_stated.

quotes.text: Colab is a hosted Jupyter Notebook service that requires no setup to use and provides free of charge access to computing resources, including GPUs and TPUs.
Colab resources are not guaranteed and not unlimited, and usage limits sometimes fluctuate.
ZeroGPU Spaces are available to use for free to all users.
Included daily quota resets exactly 24 hours after your first GPU usage.
If you receive free or other promotional credits, they expire in 90 days.
Free credits and coupons have variable expiration depending on the specific grant, ranging from 1 week to 1 year.

notes.subject: Google Cloud Free Trial
notes.text: The trial gives a $300 credit over 90 days, but while the billing account is a non-billable Free trial account you cannot add GPUs to VM instances, so it is not a free GPU offer.

quotes.text: The Free Trial gets you a $300 Welcome credit to spend over 90 days on various Google Cloud products and you won't be billed.
While your billing account is a non-billable Free trial account, you can't do any of the following: Add GPUs to your VM instances.
